name: EOSP WC-MVP-0002 Spec Path Correction Bootstrap

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - eosp/fix-wc-mvp-0002-spec-paths-bootstrap

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  correct:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Enter exact WC-MVP-0002 authorization head
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git fetch origin eosp/authorize-wc-mvp-0002
          test "$(git rev-parse origin/eosp/authorize-wc-mvp-0002)" = "5225b1241f6f23d8e8b26919d019f8f0adffa6a5"
          git checkout --detach 5225b1241f6f23d8e8b26919d019f8f0adffa6a5
          git switch -c eosp/wc-mvp-0002-spec-path-correction
          git config user.name "ChatGPT"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Correct canonical TECH-INGEST paths
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          path = Path('engineering/work-cycles/WC-MVP-0002.md')
          text = path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
          replacements = {
              'specifications/technical/TECH-INGEST-0001-markdown-engineering-artifact-parser.md':
                  'specifications/technical/TECH-INGEST-0001-markdown-engineering-artifact-parsing.md',
              'specifications/technical/TECH-INGEST-0002-structured-monad-configuration-parser.md':
                  'specifications/technical/TECH-INGEST-0002-structured-monad-configuration-parsing.md',
          }
          for old, new in replacements.items():
              if old not in text:
                  raise SystemExit(f'missing expected stale path: {old}')
              text = text.replace(old, new)
          path.write_text(text, encoding='utf-8')
          for p in (
              'specifications/technical/TECH-INGEST-0001-markdown-engineering-artifact-parsing.md',
              'specifications/technical/TECH-INGEST-0002-structured-monad-configuration-parsing.md',
              'specifications/technical/TECH-INGEST-0003-local-reference-resolution.md',
          ):
              if not Path(p).is_file():
                  raise SystemExit(f'missing canonical governing contract: {p}')
          PY

          ./scripts/eos validate WP-MVP-0001 --profile wp
          ./scripts/eos validate WP-MVP-0002 --profile wp --execution EXEC-0004
          ./scripts/eos validate WP-MVP-0003 --profile wp --execution EXEC-0005
          ./scripts/eos verify --strict
          ./scripts/eos state status
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --write
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check

      - name: Commit correction and publish to authorization branch
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git add -A
          git commit -m 'docs(eosp): correct WC-MVP-0002 governing contract paths'
          ./scripts/eos verify --strict
          ./scripts/eos state status
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check
          test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
          git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/eosp/authorize-wc-mvp-0002

metadata.title: Eosp Fix Wc Mvp 0002 Spec Paths Bootstrap
